fact: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications described law 15-04 of 1 February 2015 on general rules for electronic signature and certification as the text currently in force, covering certification and electronic signatures only; the document is dated 2025-12-01 (month proxy) and gives no other date for this.
system: Loi 15-04 du 1er février 2015 fixant les règles générales relatives à la signature et à la certification électroniques

fact: A draft law fixing general rules on trust services for electronic transactions and electronic identification, which would replace law 15-04, was presented to the National People's Assembly (APN) by the Minister, following Council of Ministers approval on 2 November 2025; it recognises electronic contracts and electronic documents as equal to paper, creates the ANCE authority and sets sanctions.
system: Projet de loi fixant les règles générales relatives aux services de confiance pour les transactions électroniques et à l'identification électronique

fact: The Algerian government approved on 2 November 2025, in the Council of Ministers, a draft law on general rules for trust services for electronic transactions and digital identification, updating the 2015 electronic signature and certification legislation and giving electronic documents, signatures, seals and timestamps legal value equal to paper.
system: Draft law on trust services for electronic transactions and electronic identification

fact: Echorouk quotes the head of the national consumer-guidance organisation for e-commerce as saying most online sellers in Algeria operate without the obligations that Law No. 18-05 on e-commerce lays down, which treats the law as existing and binding; the document gives no event date, so the 2026-08-04 publication date is used.
TSA cites law 26-02 of 17 February 2026 setting general rules on trust services for electronic transactions and identification, under which the procurement portal's electronic signature operates.
